prior_summary: Current-TCP-frame SE(3) increments make each target conditional on the actual hand pose, addressing modest intermediate-state and incoming hand-configuration mismatch.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the skill is entered early or late with TCP pose or qpos differing from nominal demonstration timing, while the peg/lid geometry remains reachable and the required release, approach, closure, or lift is still represented by successful demonstrations.
termination_guidance: Replan after each 8-action chunk. Exit only after local lifts yield a closed-gripper peg above the wall and the two observed frames show peg/TCP co-motion; then use the outgoing-overlap successor.
limitations: Local increments can drift or oscillate and do not prove feedback stability. Peg displacement is conditioned but not canceled. No demonstrations cover miss, drop, regrasp, blocked lid, or collision recovery.
